texts.ProgressiveDelivery:TrackNameAlreadyExis: A feature track named '{Name}' already exists.
texts.ProgressiveDelivery:LevelAlreadyExists: Level {Level} already exists on this track.
texts.ProgressiveDelivery:LevelNotContiguous: Levels must be contiguous. The next level for this track is {Expected}, but {Level} was given.
texts.ProgressiveDelivery:LevelNotFound: Level {Level} does not exist on this track.
texts.ProgressiveDelivery:LevelOutOfRange: Level {Level} is outside the range 0..{Highest} for this track.
texts.ProgressiveDelivery:OfficialLevelOutOfRa: The official level must be between 0 and the highest available level ({Highest}).
texts.ProgressiveDelivery:RolloutAlreadyExists: A rollout for level {Level} already exists on this track.
texts.ProgressiveDelivery:RolloutNotFound: No rollout exists for level {Level} on this track.
texts.ProgressiveDelivery:RolloutTargetMustBeA: A rollout target level must be above the official level.
texts.ProgressiveDelivery:PercentageOutOfRange: Rollout percentage must be between 0 and 10000 basis points.
texts.TracksIntro: Each track is an independently versioned behaviour with cumulative integer levels. Tracks never share state.
texts.NewTrackHelp: A new track starts with level 0 only, official level 0 and no rollouts. The name is the key used in code; keep it unique and stable.
texts.DeleteTrackHelp: Removes the track, its levels, rollouts and assignments. Transition history is kept. Callers fall back to level 0.
texts.TrackDeletionConfirmationMessage: Delete track '{0}'? Levels, rollouts and assignments are removed; history is kept.
texts.DisableTrackHelp: A disabled track resolves every subject to the official level. Assignments, rollouts and cohorts are kept but ignored until it is enabled again.
texts.DisableTrackConfirmationMessage: Disable '{0}'? Every subject drops to the official level until it is enabled again.
texts.EnableTrackConfirmationMessage: Enable '{0}'? Assignments and rollouts take effect again.
texts.KpiAboveOfficial: levels above official, across all tracks
texts.Name: Name
texts.AddLevelHelp: Level {1} is appended above the current highest level of {0}. Levels are cumulative and their numbers cannot change afterwards. Nobody receives it until an assignment or rollout puts them there.
texts.LevelsIntro: Level N includes everything from levels 0..N-1. Support descriptions explain what changes for a subject on that level.
texts.SetOfficialLevelHelp: Assignments are not modified. Anything below the new official level resolves to it; anything above stays experimental. Rollouts at or below it complete. One OfficialLevelChanged transition is recorded.
texts.NewRolloutHelp: A rollout targets one level and includes a deterministic percentage of subjects. Growth is sticky: a subject included at 1 % stays included as you grow.
texts.RolloutsIntro: Cohort membership is deterministic per subject, track and level. Pausing stops new inclusions; existing assignments stay.
texts.NoRollouts: No rollouts on this track. Add a level above the official level to start one.
texts.PercentageHelp: 0 to 100 with up to two decimals. Stored as basis points (25.00 % = 2500).
texts.AllowSkippingIntermediateLevelsHelp: Off by default: a subject must also be in the cohort of every level between official and this one.
texts.ShrinkRolloutHelp: Shrinking a percentage never removes subjects that are already assigned. Use an override or a reset for that.
texts.SuspendRolloutConfirmationMessage: Suspend the rollout for level {0}? Cohort evaluation stops; assigned subjects keep their level.
texts.RemoveRolloutConfirmationMessage: Remove the rollout for level {0}? Subjects already assigned keep their level.
texts.AssignmentsIntro: Sticky subject + track → level. An assignment below the official level is harmless and resolves to official.
texts.ResetConfirmationMessage: Remove the assignment for {0}? The subject resolves to the official level and may be picked up by a rollout cohort again.
texts.OverrideLevelHelp: Levels above official are experimental for this subject; levels below resolve to official.
texts.IsEmergencyHelp: Records the change as EmergencyOverride instead of ManualOverride. Use during incidents.
texts.SubjectIdHelp: User id, tenant id, client id or session id depending on the subject type.
texts.TrackFilterHelp: Leave empty to inspect every track.
texts.TenantIdHelp: Host only: inspect the subject inside this tenant.
texts.NoDifferences: No differences: the subject runs the official level.
texts.TransitionsIntro: Durable state changes only. Automatic demotions and emergency overrides are incidents.
texts.Subject: Subject
texts.LevelLineLegend: Solid = official (minimum for everyone). Dashed = experimental. Percentages are active rollouts.
texts.Policy:None: No automatic behaviour. The exception surfaces to the caller unchanged. Safe default for writes.
texts.Policy:DemoteOnly: Demotes the subject for future requests; nothing is re-executed now. Use for non-idempotent writes.
texts.Policy:SafeRead: Read-only route. Failure demotes and immediately retries the next lower level.
texts.Policy:Idempotent: Idempotent or transactional write. Failure demotes and retries the next lower level.
